notes.title: English version update
notes.content:
Thank you for visiting our store.
We are pleased to announce that we now support English version. We would like to keep updating the site, so thank you for your patience.

5% of the profits from the sale of this game will be donated to war orphans.
Whether you are a privileged child in a rich country or an orphan in a poor country
computer knowledge will give them strength and happiness.
May the world be peaceful and strong.

Support:
English version support.
Console screen can be displayed and cleared with F1.
Fixed minor bugs.
